items.title: Madwackd Studio Opens the Custom Creator Studio Founding Beta at $99 a Month for the First 100 Creators
items.summary: Madwackd Studio's Custom Creator Studio builds a creator a personalized dashboard from one conversation, with a human producer review, at a $99 founding rate for 12 months.
items.content_text: Madwackd Studio, the AI video studio from Denver's Madwackd Productions, today opened the Custom Creator Studio, a personalized creator dashboard built from one conversation, in a Founding Creator beta priced at $99 a month for the first 12 months. The founding rate is open to the first 100 founding creators or through November 22, 2026, whichever comes first, after which the plan renews at the regular price of $299 a month. The studio is live at [madwackd.ai/custom-creator-studio](https://www.madwackd.ai/custom-creator-studio/). A creator tells Genie, the studio's intake assistant run by its AI director Producer Z, what they make, where they post and what a good month looks like. The dashboard appears in minutes with the creator's brand on it and the studio's tools inside: scripts, hooks and captions, a voice and music mixer, a storyboard and timeline, and AI video renders priced before the creator confirms. A human producer then reviews the brand kit, tone and plan within one business day, and drafts one press release that the creator approves before it is published on the Madwackd distribution network. Creators cut, caption and export for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube, Instagra
